decision.reason: [ev-368a59fe5b7d] is just a one-line changelog commit title. It only says that bearerToken validation on the UI's Helm connect page was fixed. It doesn't describe the defect, the behaviour before and after, which setups (for example, Helm repos using bearer-token auth added through the UI) hit it, or what happens if an operator does nothing. To fill in change, applicability and consequence, we'd need the PR #22791 description or diff.
